note: I9-11D C13: the stock MessagePush model toggles push type 1 (MID 1025), a relogin proves MID 1 projects message_pushes, the stock MainSceneTouchWindow's own touch listener sends MID 1864 when first_main_touch is 0, and a second relogin shows first_main_touch 1 with no second 1864. MID 3 is the stock SelfPlayer:getServerTime path. The VC engine has no multi-touch input, so the scenario feeds the registered stock NODE_TOUCH_EVENT listener with the four all-at-once phases the stock listener expects (began, added, removed, ended) and wraps xyd.Backend.request only to count FIRST_MAIN_TOUCH sends; the first swipe is the stock hide direction and the second is the direction that requests the touch marker. No response handler is copied.
